statement: Producer development checks for a cold binary two-point decomposition baseline: nine native tests pass, preserving all prior orientation controls; complete ordered outputs agree in 528 small-curve cases and 32 GF(256) cases. At B=64 across eight targets the pair reference uses 32768 group-add calls, scalar and batch subtraction each use 512; scalar inversion calls are 438 and batch calls 7. Cold point validation, inversion internals, index inserts, lookups and output rows are explicit. This is not a timed, externally compared or independently signed performance claim.
